messages:
mara (docs): Opening a small PR to add an 'MTU & network offload' troubleshooting appendix for Private/VPC installs (covers jumbo frames, NIC offloads, and installer preflight). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4992
otto (eng-net): Can you include exact commands we recommend for 9000 MTU vs 1500 (both immediate and persistent)? Teams always ask for verbatim snippets.
mara (docs): Draft snippet: ```bash
# set MTU temporarily
ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000
# persist with NetworkManager (RHEL/CentOS)
nmcli connection modify eth0 802-3-ethernet.mtu 9000 && nmcli connection up eth0
# persist on Debian using /etc/network/interfaces example
cat >> /etc/network/interfaces.d/50-redwood.cfg <<'EOF'
iface eth0 inet static
    mtu 9000
EOF
```
zuri (eng-install): Add CNI note: for Calico set `veth_mtu` in the CNI config or pass `--mtu 9000` to calicoctl. Also remind kubelet's `--network-plugin-mtu` must match where applicable.
felix (infra): Include ethtool offload commands and a check: `ethtool -K eth0 gro on gso on tso on` and `ethtool -k eth0` to verify. Some virtual NICs auto-enable offloads; add a short warning to test in staging.
vanya (security): Air-gapped note: jumbo frames require end-to-end support (sync host, switches, and HSM links). If HSMs have fixed MTU, call that out: "do not change MTU on HSM-connected hosts without confirming appliance docs."
mara (docs): Adding a small preflight checklist: 1) ip link, 2) ping large packet test (`ping -M do -s 8972 <peer>`), 3) check CNI/veth MTU, 4) verify HSM docs, 5) run sealed bundle transfer test.
otto (eng-net): Add quick fallback tips: enable `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` or use iptables MSS clamp if fragmentation issues appear.
felix (infra): Include RHEL vs Debian persist examples (nmcli vs /etc/network/interfaces) and a note to run sealed bundle checksum after transfer.
ci-bot: PR #4992 lint: minor markdown warnings, link-checker: 1 broken anchor.
mara (docs): Will fix the anchor and push. Thanks all, will merge after CI green and one quick pass from eng-install. :thumbsup:
